pages.text: Points to the crashed ORSA relay satellite in the Overworld, which carries the transponder lead.$(br2)The tower issues the first one. Hold it like a normal compass.$(br2)$(italic)If it spins, the satellite is unresolved, or ORSA has lost another orbiting asset.$()

pages.title: Recovery Assembly
pages.text: Unlocks after your first issue, for when the original is lost to a blizzard, a ravine or an exploding backpack.$(br2)$(italic)ORSA calls it a recovery build. Finance calls it a training fee.$()
